unit: The USA 1945-1974: The People and the State
title: African Americans before Brown v Board

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of Jim Crow laws, segregated schools and the legal battles that set up the Brown v Board decision.

items.title: School Segregation and Brown v Board: Crash Course Black American History #33
items.description: Covers the legal history of school segregation from Plessy v Ferguson to the NAACP strategy behind Brown. 13 min.

items.title: Civil Rights and the 1950s: Crash Course US History #39
items.description: Broad overview of the civil rights landscape before and after Brown v Board — useful for context. 14 min.

items.title: The Help (2011)
items.description: Mississippi in the early 1960s — Jim Crow segregation in daily life, showing exactly what Brown v Board was fighting.
Jackie Robinson breaking the baseball colour barrier in 1947 — an early sign of the cracks forming in segregation.

items.title: Equal Justice Initiative — Legacy Museum
items.description: EJI documents the legal history of racial segregation and its legacy — essential context for the Brown decision.
